mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in tightening periods compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% within the last month indicates a tightening labor market, which typically leads to increased consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of falling unemployment compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of increasing RSAFS compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies struggle with production and supply chain issues.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of decreasing INDPRO compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it indicates an inflationary environment with tight monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary environment with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods meeting the trigger condition compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% month-over-month, it signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods meeting the trigger condition compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the last two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of increasing HOUST compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it indicates a weakening supply side and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% QoQ and INDPRO decrease > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods meeting the trigger condition compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
